title: SQL
tagline: Think in data, relationships, and queries
summary: SQL is the language used to work with relational data. This book takes you from the relational model and database design through queries, joins, aggregation, transactions, constraints, indexes, query optimization, security, migrations, and distributed database concepts. By the end you will be able to design reliable schemas, write complex queries, understand how databases execute them, and make architectural decisions about persistent data.
